identity.title: NEC-2 Part III Example 3 finite reflection-ground monopole

purpose: Direct published-reference conformance for finite reflection ground, including feed, current, power, pattern, average gain, null, and rotational symmetry.

origin.basis: Executable parameter facts from NEC-2 Part III Section IV Example 3 finite-ground stage; no manual prose is reproduced.

citation.title: Numerical Electromagnetics Code (NEC) - Method of Moments, Part III: User's Guide
citation.verification: Expected values were scan-checked against the official NTIS PDF.

expected_observables: the phi 0 and phi 90 pattern cuts are identical at every sampled theta
the printed 100 percent efficiency is structure efficiency and is not evidence of zero ground loss

reference_precision.policy: Compare candidate and reference half-LSD intervals with the printed exponent honored: equal centers are PASS, distinct intersecting intervals are PASS_WITH_REFERENCE_PRECISION_LIMIT, and disjoint intervals are FAIL; -999.99 dB is the publication's null sentinel.

permitted_evidence_sources: fresh internal NEC2DX report as secondary evidence only
